title: MZ Is there a Plugin to add login cloud stored server side saves?

posts.author: S3mz
posts.body:
Hey fam.
I think the question says it all, but I'm making a game that requires users to login (SSO) and fetch saved files from a server. Also to enable the storage of saved files in the same server.
Don't mind making this tool myself but would be nice to avoid the effort if there's anything else out there already.
Cheers,
